steps.message:
One flag before I touch anything.

`routes/users.js:6` is the `GET /users` response shape. Renaming `userId` → `user_id` is a breaking change for every consumer that reads that field. The README names them explicitly:

> Consumers of `GET /users`: the web app, the iOS app (3.2 and later), and the nightly partner export. Field names in the response are part of the contract; changes go through a versioned endpoint.

Shipped iOS clients can't be updated in lockstep, and the nightly partner export is outside your deploy. A straight rename breaks all three until each is updated.

The change itself is one line — I just need your call on which way to go.
